summary: Jones County fire tower site in the Croatan National Forest, known from a state tower list and one lookout guide entry; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Island Creek tower in Jones County at 35.02055, -77.14805, NGS point EY2060
Entry lists Jones County and the Croatan National Forest; no date or height given
The list notes it may include a few observation towers and Coast Guard lookouts
evidence.quote: List may include a few observation towers and Coast Guard lookouts.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a name match in two lists, with no build date, height, design or fate in any source found. The Eastern page gives county and agency only. Two web searches found nothing about a tower at Island Creek; the Croatan ranger office in New Bern and the Jones County library are untried leads. A Coastal Land Trust page about a 247-acre Island Creek property beside the forest appeared in search results; it does not mention a tower and is not used.
